paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.61 as of 2026-10-30, representing a decrease of 8.74% from the prior close and 38% over a window of 23 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has recently announced that it is advancing development at its Project Matador site while shifting its commercial strategy toward a powered-land model, as reported by Yahoo Finance on 2026-11-02. This announcement was made at the company's annual shareholder meeting, where a director vote also failed.

There have been recent filings, including four Form 4 filings and three Form 144 filings, with the most recent Form 4 filing occurring on 2026-10-22 and the most recent Form 144 filing occurring on 2026-10-20. Additionally, an 8-K form was filed on 2026-10-16, announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
